result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: an invalid delivery-price value, horizontally clipped carousel content, and the fixed bottom navigation obscuring content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays "€NaN delivery", exposing an invalid/unformatted price value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery-fee data before rendering. Show a valid amount, "Free delivery", or a clear fallback such as "Delivery fee unavailable" when the value is missing.

issues.description: The restaurant/category carousels are cut off at the right screen edge; the Trattoria card and the next category chip appear as partial slivers, which looks visually abrupt and makes the horizontal-scroll behavior less obvious.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel gutters and a deliberate partial-next-item treatment, or add a visible scroll affordance such as a fade/arrow so clipped content reads as intentional.

issues.description: The second card in the Popular right now section continues underneath the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its content partially obscured at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content to account for the fixed navigation height and safe-area inset.
